subject.title: feat: add safe hybrid local archive collection

question: Should Discrawl make hybrid upstream-snapshot collection with persistent channel-exclusion controls a supported core workflow, rather than keeping these collection policies outside the default archive path?
rationale: The PR adds durable configuration and changes collection/import semantics across several ingestion paths, so maintainers must choose the supported product contract before implementation quality alone can settle acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the core workflow
options.body: Accept hybrid collection as a supported core capability, subject to focused runtime proof of preservation and exclusion behavior.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep the underlying bug fixes but split or defer the new persistent collection-policy surface until its API and upgrade behavior are agreed.

options.title: Keep it external or experimental
options.body: Do not add this workflow to the core supported path until there is a clearer long-term ownership and support model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core workflow
recommendation.body: Accept hybrid collection as a supported core capability, subject to focused runtime proof of preservation and exclusion behavior.
